address: 呼和浩特市赛罕区大学东街东口
intro_zh: 内蒙古国际会展中心位于呼和浩特市赛罕区大学东街东口，占地9万平方米，是内蒙古自治区成立六十周年大庆的重点工程，2005年5月18日奠基、同年7月16日破土动工，总投资4亿元，由呼和浩特市政府直属的呼和浩特会展有限公司运营。它是呼和浩特乃至全自治区体量最长的大型公共建筑之一，主体长约198米、宽约152米，总建筑面积近6万平方米，其中展厅3.6万平方米、会议中心1万平方米；2015年首届中国—蒙古国博览会的展览展示活动即在此举行，此后内蒙古文化产业博览交易会、内蒙古国际农业博览会、北疆书展、年货节等常驻于此。场馆现设A1、A2、A3、B1、B2、B3共6个展馆，室内建筑面积5.5万平方米：一层可用展览面积1.8万平方米，其中A厅7200平方米、B厅10800平方米；二层展览面积1.2万平方米，现作“商品之窗”使用；三层1.2万平方米以会议为主，设14间大中小会议室，含2000平方米、可容纳1000人的多功能会议厅，装修取蒙古民族特色并配同声传译。展厅硬件上，A馆为框架混凝土结构、层高9米、净高7.4米，可布约480个标准展位；B馆为混凝土框架加球型网架屋盖、层高15米、净高12米、地面承重5吨/平方米，可布734个展位，通常用作大型特装区。室外可用展览面积2.8万平方米，南广场1.8万平方米、北广场1万平方米。交通方面，75、95、97、102、K6、S25路公交可达内蒙古会展中心站，地铁1号线市政府站、内蒙古博物院站及地铁2号线大学西街站可换乘公交抵达，自驾经大学东街直达，广场设停车场。
intro_en: Inner Mongolia International Convention and Exhibition Center sits at the east end of Daxue East Street in Saihan District, Hohhot, on a nine-hectare site. A key project for the 60th anniversary of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region, it was founded on 18 May 2005, broke ground on 16 July the same year and cost RMB 400 million; it is operated by Hohhot Exhibition Co under the municipal government. One of the longest large public buildings in Hohhot and the region, its main block measures about 198 m by 152 m with nearly 60,000 sqm of floor area, including 36,000 sqm of exhibition halls and a 10,000 sqm conference centre. The first China-Mongolia Expo held its exhibition here in 2015, and the regional cultural industry fair, Inner Mongolia International Agriculture Expo, Beijiang book fair and new year goods festival return regularly. The venue now comprises six halls - A1 to A3 and B1 to B3 - with 55,000 sqm of indoor floor area. The ground floor offers 18,000 sqm of usable exhibition space, 7,200 sqm in Hall A and 10,800 sqm in Hall B; level two has 12,000 sqm now used as a commodities showcase; level three, 12,000 sqm, is mainly for conferences, with 14 meeting rooms including a 2,000 sqm multi-function hall seating 1,000, decorated in Mongolian style with simultaneous interpretation. Hall A is a concrete frame with 9 m storey height and 7.4 m clear height, taking about 480 booths; Hall B has a concrete frame and spherical lattice roof, 15 m storey height, 12 m clear height and 5 tonnes/sqm floor loading, taking 734 booths and usually used for large custom stands. Outdoor usable space is 28,000 sqm, split between an 18,000 sqm south plaza and a 10,000 sqm north plaza. Buses 75, 95, 97, 102, K6 and S25 reach the Inner Mongolia Exhibition Center stop; Metro Line 1 at City Government and Inner Mongolia Museum, and Line 2 at Daxue West Street, connect to buses, with parking on site.
source: baike.baidu.com/内蒙古国际会展中心；cctv.com/内蒙古国际会议展览中心；nm.cnr.cn/内蒙古国际会议展览中心；haozhanhui.com/place/564

name_zh: 临沂国际会展中心（沂河路馆）
address: 临沂市沂河新区沂河路166号
intro_zh: 临沂国际会展中心（沂河路馆）位于临沂市沂河新区沂河路166号，芝麻墩一带，隶属沂河新区山东沂蒙产业发展集团，是临沂商城国际化的重要载体。临沂素称“中国物流之都、商贸名城”，也是“中国板材之都”，场馆因此与本地木业、五金、建材产业深度绑定：全国秋季五金商品交易会、中国（临沂）全屋定制暨供应链展、临沂木业产业博览会、北方家电厨卫展等常年在此举办，每年承接各类大中型展会40余场，年均接待外来观展人员约90万人次。场馆规划三个展馆，1号、2号馆已建成使用，3号馆于2026年第十届全屋定制展首次启用。1号馆建筑面积3.5万平方米、室内展览面积2万平方米，可设1000个国际标准展位，东西长250米、南北长108米，中间一排立柱间距18米，屋面最高21米、最低13.4米，设两个贵宾厅、一个会议室和一个多功能厅，是鲁南苏北地区规模最大的单体单层会展场馆；2号馆建筑面积6万余平方米、展览面积4万平方米，可设2500个国际标准展位，东西长258米、南北宽120米，共两层，一层层高12米、二层6米、屋面最高30米。已建1、2号馆室内展览面积合计6万平方米，三馆全部建成后总建筑面积20万平方米、室内展览面积超10万平方米、展位6000个、室外广场7万平方米。建筑主体为钢筋混凝土结构配大跨度钢结构屋面。交通上东接长深高速、西连京沪高速、南临岚荷高速、北靠环城高架，距临沂国际机场约5分钟车程、临沂火车站约10分钟、临沂高铁站约30分钟，并临近青岛、日照、连云港三大港口。
intro_en: Linyi International Exhibition Center (Yihe Road site) stands at 166 Yihe East Road in the Yihe New Area of Linyi, in the Zhimadun district, and is operated under Shandong Yimeng Industrial Development Group. It is a key vehicle for internationalising Linyi's wholesale market. Linyi is known as China's logistics capital and a trading city, and also as the country's plywood capital, so the venue is tightly bound to local timber, hardware and building-materials industries. The national autumn hardware fair, the China (Linyi) Whole-House Customisation and Supply Chain Exhibition, the Linyi Wood Industry Expo and the northern China kitchen and bathroom show are regular clients; more than 40 medium and large exhibitions are held here each year, drawing about 900,000 out-of-town visitors annually. Three halls are planned, of which halls 1 and 2 are already in use and hall 3 opened for the tenth whole-house customisation show in 2026. Hall 1 has 35,000 sqm of floor area and 20,000 sqm of indoor exhibition space, accommodating 1,000 standard booths; it measures 250 m east-west by 108 m north-south, with a row of columns at 18 m spacing and roof heights from 13.4 m to 21 m, and includes two VIP rooms, a meeting room and a multipurpose hall, making it the largest single-storey hall in southern Shandong and northern Jiangsu. Hall 2 offers more than 60,000 sqm of floor area and 40,000 sqm of exhibition space for 2,500 booths, measuring 258 m by 120 m over two levels, with a 12 m first floor, a 6 m upper floor and a roof peak of 30 m. Halls 1 and 2 together provide 60,000 sqm of indoor exhibition space; on full build-out the complex will reach 200,000 sqm of floor area, more than 100,000 sqm of indoor exhibition space, 6,000 booths and a 70,000 sqm outdoor plaza. The structure combines reinforced concrete with long-span steel roofing. Road access is strong: the Changshen expressway to the east, the Beijing-Shanghai expressway to the west, the Lanhe expressway to the south and the ring elevated road to the north, with Linyi International Airport about five minutes away by car.
source: zglyexpo.com/展馆简介；chinatimber.org/第八届临沂全屋定制展；qjwjh.com/秋季全国五金商品交易会参展手册；wood.friendexpo.com/第十届临沂全屋定制展

address: 浙江省义乌市文化中心区、宗泽东路59号
intro_zh: 义乌国际博览中心位于浙江省义乌市文化中心区、宗泽东路59号，北依义乌江，西邻梅湖会展中心，是义乌会展业的核心载体。义乌是全球最大的小商品集散中心，也是市场采购贸易方式的先行地，博览中心由此承担着把“市场”转化为“展场”的功能：每年秋季的中国义乌国际小商品博览会（义博会）在此举行，场馆2024年获评“最具影响力会展场馆”，并连续多年支撑义乌保持全国县级市会展综合实力首位。义博会创办于1995年，2009年移师本馆，2012年场馆整体投用，这被视为义乌从梅湖会展中心向新一代展馆升级的标志。项目由浙江中国小商品城集团投资18亿元建设，总用地219亩，总建筑面积约29.6万平方米，其中展馆24万余平方米、配套五星级酒店5.56万平方米（337间客房）；室内展览面积9.32万平方米，可提供国际标准展位5300个。展馆地上二层，设10个标准展厅，其中一个可兼作宴会厅，地下一层另有4个小型展厅及停车场；配套300—500人新闻发布厅、可容纳3500—4000人会议或400桌酒席的多功能厅、2000人快餐厅、近20间中小会议室和700余个车位。建筑上，五个两层矩形展厅呈扇形围绕中心广场展开，中间为23.3米高的通高序幕大厅，厅与厅之间通透又相对独立，屋面采用铝镁锰板。交通方面，场馆距国际商贸城约1.5公里、义乌机场约8—10公里、义乌站约14公里，803路公交直达，金义东线国际商贸城站可换乘公交，周边有杭金衢、甬金高速。
intro_en: Yiwu International Expo Center stands in the cultural district of Yiwu, Zhejiang, at 59 Zongze East Road, with the Yiwu River to the north and the older Meihu hall alongside. Yiwu is the world's largest wholesale market for small commodities and a pioneer of market procurement trade, and this venue is where that market becomes an exhibition floor. The China Yiwu International Commodities Fair, founded in 1995 and moved here in 2009, is staged every October; the centre was named one of China's most influential exhibition venues in 2024 and has helped Yiwu keep first place among county-level cities for exhibition strength. Funded by Zhejiang China Commodities City Group at a cost of RMB 1.8 billion, the complex covers 219 mu with about 296,000 sqm of floor area, including a 240,000 sqm exhibition building and a 55,593 sqm five-star hotel with 337 rooms. Indoor exhibition space totals 93,200 sqm with 5,300 standard booths. Ten standard halls occupy two levels, one convertible into a banqueting hall, with four small halls and parking underground, a 300-500 seat press room, a multi-function hall for 3,500-4,000 delegates or 400 banquet tables, a 2,000-seat food court, about 20 meeting rooms and more than 700 parking spaces. Five two-storey rectangular halls fan out around a central plaza behind a 23.3 m full-height prologue hall, roofed in aluminium-magnesium-manganese sheet. The site lies 1.5 km from the International Trade City, 8-10 km from Yiwu Airport and 14 km from Yiwu railway station; bus 803 runs direct, and the Jinhua-Yiwu-Dongyang rail line connects at International Trade City station.
source: baike.baidu.com/义乌国际博览中心；cccfair.cn/中国义乌国际小商品博览会的历史；tidenews.com.cn/第32届义博会；nes-expo.com.cn/展馆交通

address: 南京市建邺区河西新城核心区
intro_zh: 南京国际博览中心位于南京市建邺区河西新城核心区，东门在江东中路300号，北门在白龙江西街5号，由南京市河西新城区国有资产经营控股集团投资建设，美国TVS建筑设计事务所设计。它是江苏会展龙头场馆，自2008年投入使用以来，全年展览面积约占全市一半，规模性展会数量与面积占全市八成以上，并同时获得UFI与ICCA国际认证。一期工程2008年11月3日投用，最初为9座展馆（含1座路上展馆）沿主轴连廊呈弧形排列；此后扩建至12座大型无柱展馆，总建筑面积87万平方米，室内展览面积15万平方米（本库按一期口径8.355万平方米收录），室外展览面积3万平方米。单馆典型尺寸为1.2万平方米、长162米、宽72米、净高14—22米，单层无柱，尺度大于标准足球场，每馆配3间会议室，1、2号馆下设地下停车场。配套会议中心4.65万平方米，含5000平方米多功能厅、800人报告厅和20间大小会议室；另有252间精品客房与可提供5800个车位的地下双层停车场。场馆可承接展览、会议、演艺与赛事。建筑融汇南京地域特色，形成“虎踞龙盘”的整体风格，展馆以室内连廊全部贯通，动线清晰。交通方面，地铁2号线与10号线在元通站换乘，4号口出站步行约10分钟即到展馆7号门，元通站地下通道已与博览中心、国金中心等连通；从南京站、南京南站乘地铁均可在20分钟左右到达，禄口机场可经S1号线转S3号线再换2号线抵达。
intro_en: Nanjing International Expo Center occupies the heart of Hexi New Town in Jianye District, with its east gate at 300 Jiangdong Middle Road and north gate at 5 Bailongjiang West Street. Invested in by the Hexi New Town state asset group and designed by American firm TVS, it is Jiangsu's flagship exhibition venue: since opening in 2008 it has accounted for about half of the city's annual exhibition area and more than 80 per cent of its large-scale shows, and it holds both UFI and ICCA certification. Phase one opened on 3 November 2008 with nine halls, including one split-level hall, arranged in an arc along a spine corridor; later expansion brought 12 large column-free halls, 870,000 sqm of total floor area, 150,000 sqm of indoor exhibition space (this database records the phase-one figure of 83,550 sqm) and 30,000 sqm outdoors. A typical hall measures 12,000 sqm, 162 m by 72 m, with 14-22 m clear height, larger than a standard football pitch, with three meeting rooms each; halls 1 and 2 have underground parking beneath them. The 46,500 sqm conference centre includes a 5,000 sqm multi-function hall, an 800-seat auditorium and 20 meeting rooms, alongside 252 guest rooms and a two-level underground car park for 5,800 vehicles. The complex handles exhibitions, conferences, performances and sports events. Its architecture blends local character into a 'crouching tiger, coiling dragon' composition, with every hall linked by an indoor corridor. Metro Lines 2 and 10 interchange at Yuantong; exit 4 is about a ten-minute walk from gate 7, and underground passages now connect the station with the expo centre and neighbouring towers. Nanjing and Nanjing South railway stations are about 20 minutes away by metro, and Lukou Airport connects via Lines S1, S3 and 2.

address: 浙江省杭州市萧山区钱江世纪城奔竞大道353号
intro_zh: 杭州国际博览中心位于浙江省杭州市萧山区钱江世纪城奔竞大道353号，坐落在钱塘江南岸的杭州奥体博览城区块，总建筑面积85万平方米，是2016年G20杭州峰会主会场，2023年又承担杭州亚（残）运会主媒体中心和国博壁球馆，也是杭州从“西湖时代”迈向“钱塘江时代”的标志性公共建筑。场馆由北京市建筑设计研究院设计，地上五层、地下两层，设展览中心、会议中心、综合物业、屋顶花园（城市客厅）、地下商业及车库五大功能区。展览中心面积9万平方米，共10个展厅，单厅7700至10000平方米（行业目录另按室内展览面积13.9万平方米统计），设7500个国际标准展位（含1000个室外展位）；会议中心1.9万平方米、61个会议厅，主会场取“天圆地方”立意，午宴厅穹顶饰星空影像与水墨山水长卷；44米高的屋顶花园面积6万平方米，是少见的大尺度空中园林。建筑以江南意蕴结合现代简约，钢结构用量14.5万吨。场馆加入ICCA、UIA、IAEE、UFI、AIPC，是国内首个通过五大国际体系认证的专业场馆，并提出“第六代会展场馆”运营理念，以“会展+”生态圈把展览、会议、酒店与城市客厅联动起来。二期4个双层展馆正在建设，建成后一、二期总建筑面积将达130万平方米。交通方面，地铁6号线博览中心站D口出站步行约50米即达7号门，可换乘1、2、4、5、7号线；杭州东站、城站和萧山机场均可经地铁抵达。
intro_en: Hangzhou International Expo Center occupies 353 Benjing Avenue in Qianjiang Century City, Xiaoshan District, on the south bank of the Qiantang River within the Hangzhou Olympic Sports Expo City. With 850,000 sqm of gross floor area, it was the main venue of the 2016 G20 Hangzhou Summit and in 2023 served as the main media centre and the squash venue for the Hangzhou Asian Games, symbolising the city's move from the West Lake era to the Qiantang River era. Designed by the Beijing Institute of Architectural Design, it has five levels above ground and two below, organised into an exhibition centre, conference centre, ancillary property, a roof garden known as the City Lounge, underground retail and parking. The exhibition centre covers 90,000 sqm in 10 halls of 7,700 to 10,000 sqm, with 7,500 standard booths including 1,000 outdoors. The 19,000 sqm conference centre has 61 meeting rooms; the main hall follows the traditional 'round heaven, square earth' idea and the banquet hall ceiling carries starry imagery and an ink-painting landscape scroll. A 60,000 sqm roof garden sits 44 m above ground. The steel structure weighs 145,000 tonnes. The venue belongs to ICCA, UIA, IAEE, UFI and AIPC and was the first Chinese venue certified under five international management systems. A second phase of four double-deck halls is under construction, due around 2026, taking the total to 1.3 million sqm. Metro Line 6's Expo Center station, exit D, is about 50 m from Gate 7.
source: hiechangzhou.com/中心介绍；baike.baidu.com/杭州国际博览中心；zh.wikipedia.org/杭州国际博览中心

address: 西安市浐灞生态区会展一路1399号
intro_zh: 西安国际会展中心位于西安市浐灞生态区会展一路1399号，坐落在灞河之滨的欧亚经济综合园区核心区，又称西安丝路国际会展中心，与西安丝路国际会议中心、西安奥体中心合称“三中心”。它依托欧亚经济论坛和“一带一路”建设，目标是承接国际高端会务、世界级综合展会和对外交流活动，一期建成填补了西安10万平方米以上室内展馆的空缺。项目2020年5月完成AB区并投入运营，2022年1月一期12个展馆全面建成。展览部分设南北两个登录厅，一期包括2个1.6万平方米的超大展厅和10个1万平方米标准展厅，室内净展览面积13.2万平方米，其中AB区7.2万平方米，可容纳国际标准展位3344个；室外展览区分四片，共5万平方米；规划全部建成后室内净展面积可达30万平方米。项目总建筑面积约83万平方米，分两期实施。场馆特色是单层大平层布局，布展效率高，2个1.6万平方米展厅与10个标准展厅可灵活组合。建筑由同济大学建筑设计研究院与德国gmp联合设计，以“天圆地方长安月”为构思：展厅外立面采用天然石材，隐喻西安古城墙；屋顶取义古丝绸之路的沙丘，起伏轻盈；入口登录大厅为全通透玻璃幕墙，由16根巨型十字柱支撑。交通方面，地铁3号线香湖湾站B2口出站后可乘接驳车直达，公交浐灞8号线及会展1号、3号、5号线在展馆设站，从西安北站可乘地铁14号线至双寨换乘3号线，机场亦经14号线接入。
intro_en: Xi'an International Convention and Exhibition Center sits at 1399 Huizhan 1st Road in the Chanba Ecological District, on the bank of the Ba River in the core of the Eurasia Economic Zone, and is also known as the Xi'an Silk Road International Convention and Exhibition Center. Together with the Silk Road International Conference Center and the Xi'an Olympic Sports Center it forms the city's 'three centres'. Anchored in the Eurasia Economic Forum and the Belt and Road initiative, it is designed for high-level international conferences, world-class trade fairs and diplomatic events; its first phase filled Xi'an's gap in venues with more than 100,000 sqm of indoor space. Block AB opened in May 2020 and the full 12-hall first phase was completed in January 2022. Two registration halls, north and south, serve a phase-one layout of two 16,000 sqm halls and ten 10,000 sqm standard halls, giving 132,000 sqm of net indoor exhibition area, 72,000 sqm of it in Block AB, with 3,344 standard booths. Outdoor space is divided into four zones totalling 50,000 sqm, and the master plan allows 300,000 sqm of net indoor area. The whole project provides some 830,000 sqm of floor area in two phases. Its single-level, flat-floor planning is promoted as highly efficient for build-up, and the halls combine flexibly. Tongji Architectural Design and German practice gmp designed it around the idea of 'round heaven, square earth, Chang'an moon': natural stone facades echo the old city wall, the roof forms recall Silk Road dunes, and the glazed registration hall is carried on 16 giant cross-shaped columns. Metro Line 3 stops at Xianghuwan, exit B2, with a shuttle to the venue; buses Chanba 8 and Huizhan 1, 3 and 5 serve the halls, and Line 14 links Xi'an North station and the airport via Shuangzhai.

name_zh: 福州海峡国际会展中心
address: 福州市仓山区城门镇南江滨西大道198号
intro_zh: 福州海峡国际会展中心位于福州市仓山区城门镇南江滨西大道198号，坐落在闽江北岸的会展岛上，北邻闽江、南临福州火车南站，占地67万平方米，总建筑面积44万平方米，由中轴线上的会议中心连接东西两侧展馆组成。它是福州标志性建筑之一，也是国内目前唯一坐落在自贸区内的大型会展中心、单体面积最大的展馆之一。2010年5月18日建成投用，同年第十二届海峡两岸经贸交易会（“5·18”）移师于此，此后数字中国建设峰会、金砖国家政党智库和民间社会组织论坛、世界航海装备大会等相继举办，2025年获评“最具影响力会展场馆”。场馆现设10个室内展厅，净展厅面积12万平方米，可设近6000个国际标准展位；会议中心建筑面积8.6万平方米，拥有开幕大厅、大会堂、多功能厅、国际会议厅及31间各类会议室（100–700平方米，层高4–6米）；多功能厅3,263平方米、净高9米、地面平整无柱，可转为2,000人宴会厅或新闻发布厅；大会堂约3,000平方米（池座2,530平方米、二层楼座470平方米），舞台宽35米、深12.5–15米、台高1米；配套商务办公、餐饮区、地下商城、会展广场，地下停车场近千个泊位、总停车位1400—2000个，6、7号场地还可承接中型演唱会与体育赛事。建筑上两个椭圆形展馆分列东西、单体长约468米、宽约130米，与中央会议中心形成 V 字形中轴对称、舒展对称的格局。交通方面，地铁4号线会展中心站位于南江滨西大道与会展西路交叉口，出站即达；地铁1号线白湖亭、葫芦阵、黄山站距场馆约2—3公里，可换乘501路、502路公交；福州火车南站与市区方向均可经南江滨大道快速抵达。地下层设近千个泊位的停车场与商业配套，展馆北侧东西两侧各设综合服务楼。
intro_en: Fuzhou Strait International Conference and Exhibition Center stands on the exhibition island on the north bank of the Min River at 198 Nanjiangbin West Avenue, Cangshan District, with the river to the north and Fuzhou South railway station to the south. It covers 670,000 sqm with 440,000 sqm of floor area, its two exhibition wings joined by an axial conference centre. A Fuzhou landmark, it is the only large exhibition centre in China located inside a free trade zone and one of the country's largest single exhibition complexes. Completed on 18 May 2010, it took over the Cross-Strait Economic and Trade Fair that same year and has since hosted the Digital China Summit, the BRICS political parties, think tanks and civil society organisations forum, and the World Maritime Equipment Conference; in 2025 it was named a most influential exhibition venue. It now has ten indoor halls with 120,000 sqm of net exhibition space and nearly 6,000 standard booths. The 86,000 sqm conference centre contains an opening hall, a great hall of about 3,000 sqm (2,530 sqm stalls plus a 470 sqm balcony, with a stage 35 m wide and 12.5–15 m deep), a 3,263 sqm column-free multi-function hall with a 9 m clear height that converts into a 2,000-guest banquet or press room, an international conference hall, and 31 meeting rooms of 100–700 sqm with 4–6 m ceilings. Support facilities include offices, dining, an underground mall, an exhibition plaza, an underground car park of nearly 1,000 bays (1,400-2,000 spaces in total), while spaces 6 and 7 can host mid-sized concerts and sports events. Two oval exhibition buildings, each about 468 m long and 130 m wide, flank the central conference centre in a broad symmetrical composition. Metro Line 4's Huizhan Zhongxin station sits at Nanjiangbin West Avenue and Huizhan West Road, right by the venue; Line 1 stations Baihuting, Huluzhen and Huangshan are 2-3 km away with bus 501 and 502 connections, and Fuzhou South station and the city centre are a short run along Nanjiangbin Avenue. An underground level adds a car park of nearly 1,000 bays with retail space, and service buildings sit on both sides at the north end.

address: 银川市金凤区北京中路169号
intro_zh: 银川国际会展中心位于银川市金凤区北京中路169号，处在人民广场西侧，东靠银川市行政中心，西邻艾依河与拉普斯森林公园，与宁夏科技馆、宁夏博物馆、宁夏图书馆、银川艺术馆等共同围合出城市文化建筑群。它是宁夏回族自治区成立五十周年大庆的重点建设项目，也是银川“三馆两中心”之一，被视为宁夏会展经济的核心载体：2025年第七届中阿博览会、中国绿色食品博览会、宁夏养老服务业博览会等均在此举办；2024年场馆接待观展近160万人次，举办产业类、消费类品牌会展活动27场，展览面积32.65万平方米，直接产值近39亿元，占全市会展业产值的84%，场馆运营单位同年被认定为银川市会展服务集聚区。场馆占地15.9万平方米，规划建筑面积约22万平方米，其中展览中心建筑面积8.25万平方米，即本库所记8.25万平方米室内展览面积，设计国际标准展位1750个，各展厅可独立或组合使用。展馆由A、B、C、D、E五个展厅组成，沿北京路一字排开。建筑采用钢结构，表面覆以张拉膜，以轻薄膜材与玻璃的对比形成多层次空间，抗震设防烈度按8度设计；馆内已引入智慧安检与巡逻机器人，安检通行能力约每小时1300人。交通上南临北京中路、北接上海路，25路、36路、43路等多路公交在此设终点站，经银西高铁可直达河东国际机场航站楼，市区与机场之间换乘便利。
intro_en: Yinchuan International Convention and Exhibition Center stands at 169 Beijing Middle Road in Jinfeng District, on the western side of People's Square. It is backed by the Yinchuan municipal administrative centre to the east, borders the Aiyi River and Lapesen forest park to the west, and forms a cultural cluster with the Ningxia Science and Technology Museum, Museum, Library and Yinchuan Art Museum. Built as a key project for the 50th anniversary of the Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region and one of Yinchuan's 'three museums and two centres', it is the core carrier of Ningxia's exhibition economy. The seventh China-Arab States Expo in 2025, the China Green Food Expo and the Ningxia Elderly Care Service Expo have all been held here. In 2024 the venue received nearly 1.6 million visitors, hosted 27 brand exhibitions covering 326,500 sqm and generated almost RMB 3.9 billion in direct output, 84 per cent of the city's exhibition industry output; its operator was named a Yinchuan exhibition service cluster that year. The site covers 159,000 sqm with about 220,000 sqm of planned floor area, of which the exhibition centre accounts for 82,500 sqm, the indoor exhibition figure used in this database, designed for 1,750 standard booths in halls that can be used separately or combined. Five halls, A to E, line up along Beijing Road. The structure is steel clad in tensile membrane, contrasting light film with glass to create layered space, and is engineered for seismic intensity 8. Smart security screening and patrol robots now give throughput of about 1,300 people per hour. Beijing Middle Road runs along the south and Shanghai Road along the north; buses 25, 36 and 43 terminate here, and the Yinchuan-Xi'an high-speed line runs directly to the Hedong airport terminal.

name_zh: 天津国际展览中心（友谊路老国展）
address: 天津市河西区友谊路32号
intro_zh: 天津国际展览中心位于天津市河西区友谊路32号，地处市区金融商贸核心地带，毗邻天津大礼堂、天津博物馆、银河广场与天津文化中心，被本地人称作“老国展”。它始建于1989年，运营主体天津国际经济贸易展览中心有限公司成立于1987年8月24日，场馆于1989年3月15日正式开业，2003年完成扩建，是天津改革开放后最早建成并持续运营的大型专业展览场馆之一，也是天津对外宣传与承接大中型展览的主要窗口。场馆占地5.5万平方米，建筑面积4.6万平方米，室内展览面积约3.5万平方米，由一号馆与二号馆组成，两馆以二层连廊互通。一号馆1万平方米，分上下两层，可容纳400余个国际标准展位；二号馆2.5万平方米，内设五个展厅，可容纳1200余个国际标准展位；馆内另有10个不同类型会议室、洽谈室和报告厅。展厅可分可合、相对独立又灵活组合，适合举办国际国内各类大中型专业展与消费类展会。建筑为1989年建成、2003年扩建的两馆连廊式布局，是天津市区会展建筑的一段实物记录；随着天津其他大型会展场馆相继建成，全市形成多馆并存的格局，老国展以紧邻市级文化设施和市区核心区位见长。交通方面，地铁5号线、6号线的文化中心站与天津宾馆站均在步行范围内，友谊路、乐园道等城市主干道在此交汇，多路公交经停，从天津站、天津西站均可乘地铁换乘抵达。
intro_en: Tianjin International Exhibition Center stands at 32 Youyi Road in Hexi District, in the heart of the city's financial and commercial quarter, next to the Tianjin Grand Auditorium, Tianjin Museum, Galaxy Plaza and Tianjin Cultural Centre; locals call it the 'old national exhibition centre'. Its operating company was established on 24 August 1987, the venue opened on 15 March 1989 and was extended in 2003, making it one of the earliest large professional exhibition venues built and continuously run in Tianjin since reform and opening, and a principal window for the city's external promotion and mid-sized exhibitions. The site covers 55,000 sqm with 46,000 sqm of floor area and about 35,000 sqm of indoor exhibition space in two buildings linked by a second-floor corridor. Hall 1 offers 10,000 sqm over two levels for more than 400 standard booths; Hall 2 provides 25,000 sqm in five halls for over 1,200 booths; ten meeting rooms, negotiation rooms and lecture halls complete the programme. Halls can be separated or combined, giving flexible, self-contained units suited to mid-sized professional and consumer shows. Built in 1989 and extended in 2003, the linked two-hall layout is a physical record of Tianjin's urban exhibition architecture; as newer large venues opened across the city, a multi-venue landscape emerged, and the old centre's strengths remain its central location and its neighbours among the city's cultural institutions. Metro Lines 5 and 6 stop at Cultural Centre and Tianjin Hotel stations, both within walking distance; Youyi Road and Leyuan Road converge here with numerous bus routes, and Tianjin and Tianjin West railway stations are reachable by metro interchange.

address: 山东省青岛市西海岸新区沿海核心地带
intro_zh: 中铁·青岛世界博览城位于山东省青岛市西海岸新区沿海核心地带，处在滨海大道与三沙路之间的中央活力区，由中国中铁投资建设，2016年8月开工、2018年8月建成运营，已列入山东海洋经济新旧动能转换重大项目库和青岛市重点项目。作为东北亚复合型会展标杆，它把展览、会议、酒店、商业、办公与文旅休闲装进同一个园区，是青岛“会展之滨”城市名片的核心载体，也是东亚海洋合作平台青岛论坛的永久会址。国际展览中心总面积20万平方米，由12个矩形展馆组成，单馆1万平方米，室内展馆面积12万平方米，室外连廊可布展3万余平方米，可容纳6000余个国际标准展位；会议中心会议功能区3.6万平方米，设22个50至2500平方米的会议室和一个5000余平方米多功能厅，配套五星级酒店与公寓式酒店共5000余间客房、6000余个车位。展馆以海洋为主题，单馆地面承重3至5吨/平方米、单馆供电3000千瓦，适合大型机械与装备类展会，2021年通过UFI认证。建筑取当地历史遗迹“琅琊台”为造型意向，2018年获全球室内设计年度最佳公共空间设计大奖，并获建筑工程鲁班奖。交通方面，地铁13号线（西海岸快线）盛海路（世博城）站距展馆约1.6公里，展会期间常设接驳；自驾经滨海大道、沈海高速可达，展馆周边设6000余个停车位。
intro_en: China Railway Qingdao World Expo City stands on the coastal core of Qingdao's West Coast New Area in Shandong, between Binhai Avenue and Sansha Road. Built by China Railway from August 2016 and opened in August 2018, it is listed in Shandong's marine-economy new-growth project library and is a flagship of Qingdao's ambition to be a convention city on the sea; it also serves as the permanent venue of the East Asia Marine Cooperation Platform Qingdao Forum. The complex combines exhibition halls, a conference centre, hotels, offices, commerce and leisure in one park. Its International Exhibition Centre covers 200,000 sqm in total, with 12 rectangular halls of 10,000 sqm each, giving 120,000 sqm of indoor hall space plus more than 30,000 sqm of covered outdoor circulation and 6,000 international standard booths. The conference centre has 36,000 sqm of meeting space, 22 rooms from 50 to 2,500 sqm and a 5,000 sqm multifunction hall, supported by 5,000 hotel rooms and 6,000 parking spaces. Halls are themed on the ocean, carry 3–5 t/sqm floor loading and 3,000 kW power each, and received UFI certification in 2021. The architecture takes its form from the historic Langyatai terrace, won a global interior design award for best public space in 2018 and a Luban Prize. Metro Line 13 stops at Shenghai Road (Expo City), about 1.6 km away, with shuttle buses during shows; the site is reached by Binhai Avenue and the Shenhai expressway, roughly an hour from Jiaodong International Airport.
source: chuangxin.chinadaily.com.cn/青岛世界博览城；cnexpo.com/中铁·青岛世界博览城；展讯网/青岛世界博览城交通

name_zh: 台北世界贸易中心南港展览馆
address: 台北市南港区经贸二路1号
intro_zh: 台北世界贸易中心南港展览馆（TaiNEX）位于台北市南港区经贸二路1号，地处南港经贸园区，占地约6公顷。它是台湾规模最大的专业展览场馆：1馆的展示面积为台北世贸展览大楼的两倍，2馆为其1.5倍，两馆合计可规划约4700个标准展位，台北国际电脑展、国际半导体展、台北国际工具机展等旗舰展会均以此为主场，并带动南港由台肥工厂旧址向经贸园区整体转型。1馆2007年7月底完工、2008年3月13日正式营运，是台湾第一座取得绿建筑标章的展览馆；2馆2018年8月完工、2019年3月4日营运。馆内1馆设上下层展厅、13间会议室（可弹性隔为19间）、2间餐厅与9间临街商店；2馆为1楼与4楼双层展厅，另有可容纳3200人的多功能空间（3880平方米）、B1商店街及1296个汽车位。两馆室内展览面积合计约9.17万平方米。特色在于1馆上层“云端展场”屋顶跨距达126×180米、净高14.3—27.3米、全区无柱，展览空档可转办演唱会、体育赛事与大型餐会；2馆1楼挑高12米、4楼挑高9米。建筑上1馆以船桅为意象，2馆屋顶以波光粼粼的造型呼应南港早年作为北台湾重要港口的历史。交通方面，捷运文湖线、板南线南港展览馆站1号出口步行即达，高铁与台铁南港站可转板南线一站抵达，国道1号东湖交流道连接馆区。
intro_en: Taipei Nangang Exhibition Center (TaiNEX) occupies about six hectares inside the Nangang trade park at 1 Jingmao 2nd Road, Taipei. It is Taiwan's largest purpose-built exhibition complex: Hall 1 offers twice the display area of the old TWTC Exhibition Hall and Hall 2 about one and a half times, with roughly 4,700 standard booths across the two buildings. COMPUTEX, SEMICON Taiwan and Taipei International Machine Tool Show all use it as their home, and the project drove Nangang's transformation from a fertiliser factory site into a trade and exhibition district. Hall 1 was completed in July 2007 and opened on 13 March 2008, becoming Taiwan's first exhibition hall to earn a green building label; Hall 2 was completed in August 2018 and opened on 4 March 2019. Hall 1 has upper and lower exhibition floors, 13 meeting rooms divisible into 19, two restaurants and nine street-facing shops. Hall 2 has halls on levels 1 and 4, a 3,200-person multi-function space of 3,880 sqm, a B1 shopping street and 1,296 car spaces. Combined indoor exhibition area is about 91,720 sqm. Hall 1's upper 'cloud' floor spans 126 by 180 metres with a clear height of 14.3-27.3 m and no columns, allowing concerts, sports events and banquets between exhibitions; Hall 2 clears 12 m on level 1 and 9 m on level 4. Hall 1 evokes a ship's mast, while Hall 2's rippling roof recalls Nangang's history as a northern Taiwan port. MRT Wenhu and Bannan lines stop at Nangang Exhibition Center station, exit 1; Taiwan High Speed Rail and TRA Nangang station are one Bannan Line stop away, and the site connects to National Highway 1 at Donghu interchange.

address: 广东省深圳市福田区福华三路
intro_zh: 深圳会展中心位于广东省深圳市福田区福华三路，地处福田中心区南端，由深圳市政府投资兴建、深圳会展中心管理有限责任公司运营，2004年正式投入使用，是深圳第一个大型综合性会展场馆，也是中国少有的坐落于城市CBD核心区的展馆。场馆占地22万平方米，总建筑面积28万平方米，东西长540米、南北宽282米，地上6层、地下2层，地面以上最高处60米。一层9个展厅沿“U”形铺设，室内展览面积10.5万平方米，可容纳5000个国际标准展位；会议中心悬浮于展馆之上，设35间会议室，可兼作中高档餐饮场地；二层服务主通道长480米，贯穿东西，集中提供展会配套服务；9个展厅沿“U”形连续布局、二层480米主通道贯穿东西，是场馆最鲜明的空间特色。建筑将钢结构、玻璃穹顶与幕墙结合，夜间灯光下通体晶莹，有“水晶宫”之誉。场馆以中国国际高新技术成果交易会（高交会）和中国（深圳）国际文化产业博览交易会（文博会）为龙头品牌，高交会展览面积达15万平方米，被称为“中国科技第一展”；2004年以来深圳会展业迅速跃居全国前列。交通方面，地铁1号线、4号线会展中心站D口步行约10分钟可达，会展中心北、东、南三侧设多个公交站；步行15分钟至福田高铁站，乘高铁14分钟可抵香港西九龙，距宝安国际机场约30分钟车程。
intro_en: Shenzhen Convention and Exhibition Center occupies the southern edge of Futian central district on Fuhua Third Road, Shenzhen, Guangdong. Funded by the municipal government and run by Shenzhen Convention & Exhibition Center Management Co., it opened in 2004 as the city's first large integrated exhibition venue and is one of the few Chinese halls set inside a CBD core. The site covers 220,000 sqm with 280,000 sqm of floor area, 540 m from east to west and 282 m from north to south, six levels above ground and two below, rising 60 m. Nine halls are laid out in a U shape on level one, giving 105,000 sqm of indoor exhibition space and 5,000 standard booths. The conference centre floats above the halls with 35 meeting rooms that double as dining space, and a 480 m service corridor on level two runs east to west with support services. Steel structure, a glass dome and curtain walls combine so that the building glows at night, earning it the name Crystal Palace. The venue anchors the China Hi-Tech Fair, whose 150,000 sqm edition is known as China's leading technology show, and the China (Shenzhen) International Cultural Industries Fair; after 2004 Shenzhen's exhibition industry rose quickly into the national top tier. Metro Lines 1 and 4 stop at Convention & Exhibition Center station, exit D, about ten minutes' walk away, with bus stops on three sides. Futian high-speed rail station is a 15-minute walk, Hong Kong West Kowloon is 14 minutes by train, and Bao'an International Airport is about 30 minutes by car.

address: 浙江省金华市永康市五湖路1号
intro_zh: 永康国际会展中心位于浙江省金华市永康市五湖路1号，北接总部中心、南邻市委党校，东靠330国道，由浙江中国科技五金城集团投资建设，2011年建成，是“五金之都”永康唯一的大型专业展馆，也是中国五金博览会的永久举办地。永康五金产业历史悠久，中国五金博览会自1996年创办，已连续举办三十届，从最初的商交馆发展到今天的现代国际会展中心，展会成为全国五金行业的风向标。场馆总用地17.6万平方米，总建筑面积16.2万平方米，由10个展厅、序厅、办公楼和10万平方米广场组成；展厅建筑面积12.1万平方米，单厅7560平方米，10个展厅净面积合计约7.56万平方米（行业目录按室内展览面积计约9.46万平方米），设室内标准展位3500个、室外展位1500个，广场停车泊位1800个。序厅1.9万平方米、地上四层、高31.5米，设主席台、信息发布厅和千人多功能厅；办公楼2.2万平方米，东西塔楼高71米，外立面设6块共2200平方米的室外全彩显示屏。整体建筑形如一只展翅朝阳的凤凰，展厅采用水冷空调，配53部电梯和1216个展位箱。交通方面，330国道从馆前通过，距永康南站（高铁）约20分钟车程，可乘11路公交至总部中心站后步行约800米，周边与永康中国科技五金城、总部中心连成一片。
intro_en: Yongkang International Convention and Exhibition Center is at 1 Wuhu Road, Yongkang, Jinhua, Zhejiang, between the headquarters business district to the north and the party school to the south, with National Highway 330 on its east. Invested by Zhejiang China Science and Technology Hardware City Group and completed in 2011, it is the only large professional exhibition venue in Yongkang, the hardware capital of China, and the permanent home of the China Hardware Fair. That fair began in 1996 and has run for thirty editions, growing from a simple trade hall into the country's benchmark hardware show and a bellwether for the industry. The venue covers a 176,000 sqm site with 162,000 sqm of floor area, made up of ten halls, a registration hall, an office building and a 100,000 sqm plaza. Hall buildings total 121,000 sqm, each hall 7,560 sqm, with about 75,600 sqm of net hall area, 3,500 indoor and 1,500 outdoor standard booths and 1,800 parking spaces. The 19,000 sqm registration hall rises four levels to 31.5 m and contains a rostrum, a press room and a 1,000-seat multifunction hall; the 22,000 sqm office building has 71 m towers and six outdoor LED screens totalling 2,200 sqm. The complex is shaped like a phoenix rising towards the sun, with water-cooled air conditioning, 53 lifts and 1,216 service boxes. National Highway 330 passes the front; Yongkang South high-speed rail station is about 20 minutes by car, with bus 11 to Headquarters Center and a short walk beyond.
source: eshow365.com/永康国际会展中心；baike.baidu.com/永康国际会展中心；新华网/中国五金博览会；浙江省国际会议展览业协会

name_zh: 安徽滨湖国际会展中心
address: 安徽省合肥市滨湖新区锦绣大道3899号
intro_zh: 合肥滨湖国际会展中心位于安徽省合肥市滨湖新区锦绣大道3899号，东邻庐州大道、北临锦绣大道，占地58.62公顷，总建筑面积约35万平方米，2012年投入使用，由合肥市与滨湖新区共同投资建设，是安徽承接世界制造业大会、中国地理信息产业大会、中国黄山书会等高级别活动的核心场地，也是合肥会展经济从老城区5万平方米场馆向滨湖新区扩容的关键一步。场馆分两期：一期室内展场9.1万平方米，含登录大厅、主展馆和6个标准展厅共7个室内展厅，另有1.55万平方米室外展场和1.5万平方米会议区；二期总建筑面积13.15万平方米，由1座综合馆、2座标准馆组成，新增室内展场4万平方米、会议区0.5万平方米，两期合计室内展览面积约13.1万平方米、10个展厅。二期综合馆屋面钢桁梁跨度144米，为国内最大跨度张弦桁架会展建筑，采用直径218毫米半平行PE拉索，室内1.9万平方米无柱大空间并配可移动伸缩阶梯座椅；两座标准馆各1.6万平方米，地面荷载5吨/平方米。项目获中国钢结构金奖和2022—2023年度鲁班奖。交通方面，合肥轨道交通（地铁）1号线滨湖会展中心站位于庐州大道与锦绣大道交口，出站即到；周边有十五里河生态公园和多条公交线路，经庐州大道、包河大道可快速连接主城与合肥南站。
intro_en: Hefei Binhu International Exhibition and Convention Center is at 3899 Jinxiu Avenue in the Binhu New Area of Hefei, Anhui, a 58.62-hectare site bounded by Luzhou Avenue and Jinxiu Avenue. Opened in 2012 and jointly invested by the city and the new-area authorities, it is Anhui's principal large public exhibition venue and has hosted the World Manufacturing Convention, the China Geographic Information Industry Conference and the Huangshan Book Fair. The complex totals about 350,000 sqm of floor area in two phases. Phase one provides 91,000 sqm of indoor exhibition space in seven halls — a registration hall, a main hall and six standard halls — plus 15,500 sqm outdoors and 15,000 sqm of meeting space. Phase two, with 131,500 sqm of floor area, adds a general hall and two standard halls, contributing 40,000 sqm indoors and 5,000 sqm of meetings, bringing the site to about 131,000 sqm of indoor exhibition space in ten halls. The phase-two general hall has a 144 m steel truss roof, described as the longest-span string-truss exhibition structure in China, using 218 mm semi-parallel PE cables, and offers 19,000 sqm of column-free space with retractable tiered seating; the two standard halls are 16,000 sqm each with 5 t/sqm floor loading. The project won a China Steel Structure Gold Award and a 2022–2023 Luban Prize. Metro Line 1 stops at Binhu Huizhan Zhongxin station at Luzhou and Jinxiu avenues, next to the venue.

address: 上海市青浦区徐泾镇盈港东路168号
intro_zh: 国家会展中心（上海）位于上海市青浦区徐泾镇盈港东路168号，地处虹桥商务区核心区西部，是长三角的会展门户。项目由商务部和上海市人民政府于2011年共同决定合作共建，总投资约160亿元，由国家会展中心（上海）有限责任公司投资建设并运营，是中国国际进口博览会的永久举办地，也是上海建设“国际会展之都”的核心载体。2014年12月31日竣工、2015年投入使用，建成时是当时世界最大的会展综合体之一，并成为国内首家大型会展类绿色建筑设计与运行“双三星”场馆。综合体总占地面积86万平方米、总建筑面积147万平方米，共17个展厅：15个单位面积3万平方米的大展厅加2个单位面积1万平方米的多功能展厅，室内展厅近50万平方米，另有10万平方米室外展场，可展览面积近60万平方米。其中3个单层无柱展厅净高34米、穹顶跨度108米，一层北片4馆地面荷载达每平方米5吨，重型机械展可直入。建筑以“四叶草”为造型，四片叶瓣汇聚于1万平方米中央广场，轴线对称，东厅“虹馆”设近8000个座位。场馆与虹桥交通枢纽直线距离仅1.5公里，经空中连廊、地下通道和地铁2号线、17号线国家会展中心站直连虹桥火车站与虹桥机场，周边高速路网1至2小时可达长三角主要城市。
intro_en: The National Exhibition and Convention Center (Shanghai) stands at 168 Yinggang East Road, Xujing Town, Qingpu District, in the western core of the Hongqiao business district, and serves as the exhibition gateway to the Yangtze River Delta. Jointly decided by the Ministry of Commerce and the Shanghai Municipal Government in 2011, with investment of about RMB 16 billion, it is built and operated by NECC (Shanghai) Co., Ltd., is the permanent home of the China International Import Expo, and is the anchor of Shanghai's ambition to become an international exhibition city. Completed on 31 December 2014 and opened in 2015, it was among the largest exhibition complexes in the world when built, and became the first large Chinese exhibition venue to earn triple-star green-building certification for both design and operation. The complex covers 860,000 square metres of land with 1.47 million square metres of floor area and 17 halls: fifteen halls of 30,000 square metres each plus two multifunctional halls of 10,000 square metres, giving nearly 500,000 square metres indoors, 100,000 square metres of outdoor space and close to 600,000 square metres in total. Three single-storey pillar-free halls reach 34 metres in clear height with a 108-metre roof span, and four northern ground-floor halls carry five tonnes per square metre. The architecture is a four-leaf clover, its leaves converging on a 10,000-square-metre central plaza, with the 8,000-seat Hong Hall in the east wing. The site is 1.5 kilometres from Hongqiao transport hub, linked by skywalks, underpasses and Metro Lines 2 and 17 to Hongqiao railway station and airport, with expressways reaching major Delta cities in one to two hours.

address: 山东省济南市槐荫区日照路1号
intro_zh: 山东国际会展中心位于山东省济南市槐荫区日照路1号，地处济南西客站核心片区，东至二环西路、北至威海路，由济南城市建设集团所属山东国际会展集团运营，2019年投入使用，是济南首个单体净展览面积超过10万平方米的大型展馆，与舜耕国际会展中心、济南国际会展中心形成错位互补的会展格局。场馆总建筑面积约35.2万平方米，地上22.6万平方米、地下12.6万平方米，室内展览面积10万平方米，室外展场2.5万平方米，可提供近5000个国际标准展位。展馆共三层、8个展厅，一层自北向南为1至5号馆、二层为6至8号馆，每厅1.15万平方米，空间高度均在10米以上；一层登录厅2万平方米，M层为标准会议层，三层为2万平方米国际会议中心，含5300平方米黄河厅、1050平方米泰山厅等。结构采用最大跨度72米的单层钢结构梁，每馆设6个卸货口，一层地面承重5吨/平方米、二层3吨/平方米、三层1吨/平方米。建筑设计围绕“泉水”展开，屋面取船行河上的流动感，展馆之间以共享大厅连通。交通方面，地铁2号线二环西路站距展馆约500米，20余条公交线路可达；距济南西站3公里、济南遥墙机场约40公里，紧邻机场高速与市区快速路，周边设有约2700个车位。
intro_en: Shandong International Convention and Exhibition Center is at 1 Rizhao Road, Huaiyin District, Jinan, in the core area of the Jinan West railway station district, bounded by Erhuan West Road and Weihai Road. Operated by Shandong International Convention & Exhibition Group under Jinan Urban Construction Group, it opened in 2019 as Jinan's first single venue with more than 100,000 sqm of net exhibition space, complementing the older Shungeng and Jinan international centres. The building totals about 352,000 sqm, 226,000 above ground and 126,000 below, with 100,000 sqm of indoor exhibition space, 25,000 sqm of outdoor yard and nearly 5,000 standard booths. It has three levels and eight halls: halls 1 to 5 on the ground floor from north to south and halls 6 to 8 above, each 11,500 sqm with a clear height above 10 m. The 20,000 sqm ground-floor registration hall, a mezzanine meeting level and a 20,000 sqm international conference centre on level three — including the 5,300 sqm Yellow River Hall and the 1,050 sqm Mount Tai Hall — complete the stack. The structure uses single-storey steel beams with a maximum span of 72 m; each hall has six loading doors and floor loading of 5, 3 and 1 t/sqm on levels one to three. The design draws on Jinan's springs, with roofs that suggest boats moving on water and shared lobbies linking the halls. Metro Line 2's Erhuan West Road station is about 500 m away; Jinan West station is 3 km and Yaoqiang Airport about 40 km, with some 2,700 parking spaces.
source: zwhz.com/山东国际会展中心展馆介绍；baike.baidu.com/山东国际会展中心；济南本地宝/交通

address: 江苏省苏州市工业园区CBD核心区、金鸡湖北岸
intro_zh: 苏州国际博览中心位于江苏省苏州市工业园区CBD核心区、金鸡湖北岸，占地15.4万平方米，建筑面积35万平方米，2004年正式对外运营，2012年与苏州文化艺术中心合并运营、组建苏州文化博览中心，是苏州会展业的核心载体，也是长三角重要的展览会议综合体。场馆室内展厅面积约10万平方米（官网简介另记7.8万平方米），拥有9个展厅；会议面积5万平方米、60间会议室，其中包括8000平方米亚洲超大无柱豪华宴会厅，可满足大型展览、会议、宴会与演艺的复合需求。整体造型像一把打开的苏州折扇，扇片状屋顶采用不锈钢与玻璃，阳光下闪亮，与扇形体量、前庭、小河、景观花园和林荫大道融为一体；设计将酒店与会议按水平、垂直分区叠加，二层设8000平方米无柱宴会厅。场馆同时拥有ICCA、IAEE、UFI会员资格，打造“苏式精致会展”品牌，承接过大运河文化旅游博览会、国际风景园林师联合会世界大会、第53届世界乒乓球锦标赛、中国国际医疗器械博览会等。交通方面，地铁1号线文化博览中心站2号口出站可直达G馆，苏州园区站约5分钟车程、苏州站约20分钟；周边国际博览中心站有2路、47路、108路等十余条公交，地下停车场约850个车位。
intro_en: Suzhou International Expo Center sits in the CBD of Suzhou Industrial Park on the northern shore of Jinji Lake, Jiangsu, on a 154,000 sqm site with 350,000 sqm of floor area. It opened in 2004 and in 2012 merged with the Suzhou Culture and Arts Centre to form the Suzhou Culture Expo Centre; it is the core carrier of Suzhou's exhibition industry and a major integrated venue in the Yangtze River Delta. Indoor exhibition space is about 100,000 sqm in nine halls, although one official profile gives 78,000 sqm. Meeting space of 50,000 sqm includes 60 rooms and an 8,000 sqm column-free ballroom described as one of Asia's largest, so the venue can host exhibitions, conferences, banquets and performances. The overall form resembles an open Suzhou folding fan: the fan-shaped roof is clad in stainless steel and glass and glitters in sunlight, merging with the forecourt, a small river, landscape gardens and tree-lined avenues. Hotels and meeting space are stacked in horizontal and vertical zones, with the ballroom on level two. The centre holds ICCA, IAEE and UFI membership and promotes a refined Suzhou-style service brand, having hosted the Grand Canal Culture and Tourism Expo, the IFLA World Congress, the 53rd World Table Tennis Championships and CMEF. Metro Line 1's Culture and Expo Center station, exit 2, leads directly to Hall G; Suzhou Industrial Park station is five minutes away by car and Suzhou station about 20, with some 850 underground parking spaces.
source: suzhouexpo.com/苏州国际博览中心；js.chinanews.com.cn/苏州国际博览中心；苏州本地宝/展馆交通

address: 成都市天府新区福州路东段88号
intro_zh: 中国西部国际博览城位于成都市天府新区福州路东段88号，处在天府新区总部商务区，是四川省、成都市共同打造的中西部最大会展综合体，也是中国西部国际博览会的永久会址。项目2014年6月动工，2016年7月竣工验收，2017年9月正式投运，二期天府国际会议中心于2021年投入使用，形成展览加会议的完整业态，并加入UFI、ICCA、IAEE等国际行业组织。一期国际展览展示中心总建筑面积57万平方米，室内净展面积20.5万平方米，由15个面积约1.2万平方米的标准展厅和1个多功能厅组成，共16个展厅，可布置1.1万个室内国际标准展位，室外展场10余万平方米，另配办公、餐饮、停车及10万平方米专用货运轮候区。开馆以来承接中国西部国际博览会、全国糖酒商品交易会、成都国际车展等20万平方米以上生根型展会，并获国家优质工程奖、詹天佑奖、中国钢结构金奖与鲁班奖。建筑整体立意“锦秀山水”，连绵起伏的屋顶与公共大厅共同形成“水浣蜀锦”的意象；展厅采用大跨度双曲面桁架与网架结构，馆内无柱，用钢量与“鸟巢”相当，主广场一侧玻璃幕墙竖向跨度最大58米。地铁1号线、18号线西博城站直达，场馆及周边停车位逾万个。
intro_en: Western China International Expo City is located at 88 Fuzhou Road East, Tianfu New Area, Chengdu, in the headquarters business district of the national-level new area. Jointly developed by Sichuan Province and Chengdu Municipality as the largest exhibition complex in central and western China, it is the permanent venue of the Western China International Fair. Construction began in June 2014, the project passed completion inspection in July 2016 and full operation started in September 2017, while the Tianfu International Conference Center phase opened in 2021 to complete an exhibition-plus-convention offer; the venue belongs to UFI, ICCA and IAEE. The phase-one exhibition centre has 570,000 square metres of floor area and 205,000 square metres of net indoor exhibition space in 16 halls, comprising fifteen standard halls of about 12,000 square metres each plus one multifunctional hall, enough for 11,000 international standard booths, with more than 100,000 square metres outdoors, plus offices, catering, parking and a 100,000-square-metre truck holding area. Since opening it has hosted the Western China International Fair, the National Sugar and Wine Fair and the Chengdu Motor Show, and has won the National Quality Engineering Award, the Zhan Tianyou Award, the China Steel Structure Gold Award and the Luban Prize. The architecture takes "splendid landscape" as its theme, rolling roofs and the public hall forming the image of water washing Sichuan brocade; the halls use long-span double-curved trusses and space frames without internal columns, a steel tonnage comparable to the Bird's Nest, and a glass curtain wall spanning up to 58 metres vertically. Metro Lines 1 and 18 stop at Xibocheng station.

name_zh: 昆明滇池国际会展中心
address: 云南省昆明市官渡区环湖东路
intro_zh: 昆明滇池国际会展中心位于昆明市官渡区福保半岛、滇池之滨，处于滇池三个半岛片区，2015年建成并投入使用，是云南省集展会、酒店、商业、休闲于一体的标志性工程，也是中国—南亚博览会暨昆明进出口商品交易会的主要会场，承担着面向南亚东南亚开放的窗口功能。项目总占地面积约2331亩，总建筑面积约540万平方米，按场馆运营方口径，其会展规模位列全国第三、西南第一；其中一期展馆及配套建筑面积约117万平方米。场馆共23个展馆，单馆面积约1万平方米，其中无柱展馆13个、约20万平方米，有柱展馆10个、约10万平方米，室内展览面积约30万平方米，室外展览面积约10万平方米，可提供约1.5万个国际标准展位。会议中心面积2万平方米，设64间77平方米洽谈室、15间272至425平方米会议室、28间贵宾室、1个1330平方米多功能厅与1个468平方米报告厅，配套宴会厨房可满足3000人同时就餐，地下固定停车位近8000个。建筑以“孔雀展屏，祥瑞春城”为设计理念，钢结构采用变截面薄壁异型弯扭全焊接空间结构，获国家优质工程奖。周边以地铁5号线、环湖东路与绕城高速连接主城，距长水国际机场约15公里。
intro_en: Kunming Dianchi International Convention and Exhibition Center sits on the Futao peninsula on the shore of Dianchi Lake in Guandu District, Kunming, within the city's three-peninsula lakefront area. Completed and opened in 2015, it is Yunnan's landmark project combining exhibition, hotel, retail and leisure functions, the principal venue of the China-South Asia Expo and the Kunming Import and Export Fair, and the province's window for engagement with South and Southeast Asia. The site covers about 2,331 mu with roughly 5.4 million square metres of floor area, which the operator ranks third nationally and first in southwest China, of which phase one halls and supporting space account for about 1.17 million square metres. There are 23 halls of about 10,000 square metres each: thirteen pillar-free halls totalling some 200,000 square metres and ten columned halls of about 100,000 square metres, giving around 300,000 square metres indoors and 100,000 square metres outdoors, enough for about 15,000 international standard booths. A 20,000-square-metre conference centre provides 64 negotiation rooms of 77 square metres, fifteen meeting rooms of 272 to 425 square metres, 28 VIP rooms, a 1,330-square-metre multipurpose hall and a 468-square-metre lecture theatre, with banquet kitchens serving 3,000 diners and nearly 8,000 underground parking spaces. The design concept, "peacock spreading its tail, auspicious spring city", is realised through a welded spatial steel structure of variable-section thin-walled twisted members that won a National Quality Engineering Award. Metro Line 5, Huanhu East Road and the ring expressway connect the site with the city centre, about 15 kilometres from Changshui International Airport.

address: 厦门市思明区会展路198号
intro_zh: 厦门国际会展中心位于厦门市思明区会展路198号，坐落在环岛路北侧、厦门岛东南海岸，与小金门隔海相望，直线距离约4600米，是厦门会展产业的核心载体和城市标志性建筑。中心自1998年10月1日动工、2000年9月8日一期启用，此后分期扩建至五期；一期投资11.7亿元、总建筑面积16.5万平方米，设5个室内展厅、展厅面积3.3万平方米，建成时是国内占地面积最大、展厅层高最高、单体体量最大的展馆。2023年7月五期D馆竣工交付，占地约3万平方米、总建筑面积超7万平方米，展厅面积近1.5万平方米、会议面积近1万平方米，会议室可分隔为18间独立会议室，使中心总展览面积超过20万平方米。主场馆现设23个展厅、展厅面积合计约20万平方米，可设8200个国际标准展位，另配多功能厅、国际会议厅及74间会议室与贵宾室。中心是中国国际投资贸易洽谈会（投洽会）主会场，2017年金砖国家领导人会晤亦在此举行。建筑如大鹏展翅又如巨轮起航，各期以轴线对称协调统一；五期立面取闽南传统建筑意象，竖向铝板与玻璃幕墙相间如钢琴键盘。交通经地铁2号线软件园二期站、环岛路及高崎国际机场（约15公里）接驳。
intro_en: Xiamen International Conference and Exhibition Center is located at 198 Huizhan Road, Siming District, on the north side of Huandao Road along Xiamen Island's southeast coast, facing Little Kinmen across roughly 4,600 metres of sea. It is the core asset of the city's exhibition industry and one of its landmark buildings. Construction began on 1 October 1998 and the first phase opened on 8 September 2000, followed by successive expansions up to a fifth phase; phase one cost RMB 1.17 billion and provided 165,000 square metres of floor area with five indoor halls totalling 33,000 square metres, and when completed it was the largest-footprint, highest-clearance and largest single-volume exhibition venue in China. In July 2023 the fifth-phase Hall D was completed, covering about 30,000 square metres of land with more than 70,000 square metres of floor area, nearly 15,000 square metres of exhibition space and some 10,000 square metres of conference space whose rooms can be divided into 18 separate meeting rooms, lifting total exhibition space above 200,000 square metres. The main complex now has 23 halls with about 200,000 square metres in total, 8,200 international standard booths, plus a multipurpose hall, an international conference hall and 74 meeting and VIP rooms. It is the main venue of the China International Fair for Investment and Trade and hosted the 2017 BRICS leaders' summit. The architecture suggests a roc spreading its wings or a great ship setting sail, with each phase aligned on the same axis; the fifth phase draws on southern Fujian building traditions, its vertical aluminium panels and glass curtain wall alternating like piano keys.

address: 辽宁省沈阳市苏家屯区会展路9号
intro_zh: 沈阳国际展览中心位于辽宁省沈阳市苏家屯区会展路9号，由沈阳市人民政府全额投资建设，总用地95.9万平方米，一期总建筑面积16.6万平方米，室内展览面积10.56万平方米、室外展览面积20万平方米，是东北地区单体规模最大的专业展馆之一；按公开口径，其整体规模居东北首位、国内第五，也是沈阳承接糖酒会、药机展、农机展、教育装备展等特大型展会的主力场馆。中心由8个单层、无柱、大跨度独立展厅组成，东西两侧各4个，单厅1.32万平方米，可设625个国际标准展位，全馆可容5000个展位；展厅采用70米大跨度结构，净高18至28米，室内地面承重5吨/平方米。两列展厅之间由二层综合服务连廊衔接，配会议中心（1000人会议厅、600人新闻发布厅等）及商务、餐饮配套；东、南、西、北四面设登录厅，室外分东、南、北三个展场，周边10处停车场可同时停放7500辆车。建筑以大体量单层展馆加拱形屋顶为特征，功能分区明确、货运流线独立。交通方面，场馆距沈阳市区12公里、桃仙国际机场13公里、沈阳南站3.5公里，多条高速、公交、巴士专线与有轨电车汇集；地铁10号线二期规划设国展中心站，目前仍在建设。
intro_en: Shenyang International Exhibition Center is at 9 Huizhan Road, Sujiatun District, Shenyang, Liaoning, wholly invested by the Shenyang municipal government on a 959,000 sqm site. Phase one has 166,000 sqm of floor area, 105,600 sqm of indoor exhibition space and 200,000 sqm outdoors; public sources rank it first in northeast China and fifth nationally among single venues, and it is the city's main host for very large shows such as the sugar and liquor fair, pharmaceutical machinery, agricultural machinery and education equipment exhibitions. The centre is formed of eight independent single-storey, column-free, long-span halls, four on the east and four on the west, each 13,200 sqm and able to take 625 standard booths, for 5,000 booths in total. The halls use a 70 m span with a clear height of 18–28 m and 5 t/sqm floor loading. A two-storey service corridor links the two rows, with meeting space including a 1,000-seat hall and a 600-seat press room, plus business and catering facilities. Registration halls sit on all four sides; outdoors there are east, south and north yards, and ten car parks around the site hold 7,500 vehicles. The architecture is defined by the large single-storey volumes and arched roofs, with separate freight routes. The venue is 12 km from the city centre, 13 km from Taoxian International Airport and 3.5 km from Shenyang South station; expressways, buses, shuttle lines and trams converge here, and a station on Metro Line 10 phase two is under construction.

address: 重庆市两江新区悦来会展城
intro_zh: 重庆国际博览中心位于重庆市两江新区悦来会展城，地址为渝北区悦来大道66号，北接悦来古镇、西邻嘉陵江、东靠丘陵起伏的会展公园，是重庆建设内陆开放高地和承接大型展会的主场馆。项目由重庆市国资委直属的重庆悦来投资发展有限公司投资建设，2013年建成投用，建成时以“全球前十、国内第二、西部最大”的规模定位成为重庆首个大型专业展馆，总建筑面积60万平方米，室内展览面积20万平方米，设16个全平层无柱展厅，南北各布置8个，单个展厅使用面积1.15万平方米，地面承重每平方米3至5吨，重型设备可直接进馆，室外另设展场并配1.1万个停车位。南北展区之间的多功能厅使用面积2万平方米、净高约19至28米，可容纳1.5万个座位，是西南地区少见的万人级室内场地；配套悦来国际会议中心拥有3个1000平方米以上会议厅、5200平方米无柱宴会厅和47间会议室。建筑自空中俯瞰如一只巨型蝴蝶，屋面以铝格栅镂空曲面覆盖，面积达53.7万平方米、用铝型材约1万吨，形成“城市、森林、自然”一体的公园展馆形象。交通依托国博线与10号线在悦来站换乘、国博中心站下车，经机场高速连接江北国际机场。
intro_en: Chongqing International Expo Center stands in Yuelai Convention and Exhibition City, the core of Chongqing's Liangjiang New Area, at 66 Yuelai Avenue in Yubei District, with Yuelai old town to the north, the Jialing River to the west and a rolling exhibition park to the east. Invested in by Chongqing Yuelai Investment and Development Co., Ltd., a municipal state-owned enterprise under the SASAC, and opened in 2013, it was billed at completion as a top-ten venue worldwide, second in China and the largest in western China, and remains the city's principal venue for large exhibitions and a symbol of Chongqing's inland opening-up. The complex has 600,000 square metres of floor area and 200,000 square metres of indoor exhibition space in 16 fully level, pillar-free halls, eight on the north side and eight on the south, each with 11,500 square metres of usable area and floor loading of three to five tonnes per square metre so that heavy equipment can drive straight in; outdoor space and 11,000 parking spaces complete the exhibition zone. Between the two hall clusters, a 20,000-square-metre multipurpose hall with a clear height of 19 to 28 metres seats 15,000 people, one of the few indoor venues of that scale in southwest China, while the Yuelai International Conference Center adds three halls of over 1,000 square metres, a 5,200-square-metre pillar-free ballroom and 47 meeting rooms. Seen from above the complex resembles a giant butterfly, its roof a perforated aluminium grid shell covering 537,000 square metres and using about 10,000 tonnes of aluminium extrusions, creating the image of a park venue where city, forest and nature merge. Line 10 and the Guobo line meet at Yuelai, with Guobozhongxin station serving the halls.

address: 广东省广州市海珠区琶洲岛阅江中路380号
intro_zh: 广交会展馆（中国进出口商品交易会展馆）位于广州市海珠区琶洲岛，是广交会的举办场馆，也是广州会展业的核心载体和城市地标。广交会创办于1957年，是中国历史最长、规模最大的综合性国际贸易盛会，被誉为“中国第一展”；展馆先后四次迁址，从中苏友好大厦到侨光路、起义路、流花路，最终落户琶洲，展览面积从9600平方米增至逾百万平方米。琶洲展馆2004年一期启用、2008年A、B、C三区全面启用，四期扩建2020年12月启动、2022年12月30日D区展馆与东登录厅率先投用、2024年10月整体通过验收，形成A、B、C、D四大展区格局。展馆总建筑面积超162万平方米，展览面积62万平方米，其中室内50.4万平方米、室外11.6万平方米，四区共20个展厅，设有5个万平方米级无柱展厅，新增展位近6000个，成为全球规模最大的会展综合体之一。四期建筑沿用A、B区“飘”的外形，D区18.2号馆最高约13米、最低11.5米，面积超1万平方米，可容572个展位。场馆配套广交会堂会议中心、指挥中心与广交会大厦，地铁8号线、11号线及琶洲港澳客运码头构成水陆交通网络。
intro_en: The Canton Fair Complex, formally the China Import and Export Fair Complex, occupies Pazhou Island in Haizhu District, Guangzhou. It hosts the Canton Fair, the core asset of the city's exhibition industry and one of its landmarks. Founded in 1957, the Canton Fair is China's longest-running and largest comprehensive international trade event, known as "China's No.1 Exhibition"; the venue has moved four times, from the Sino-Soviet Friendship Building to Qiaoguang Road, Qiyi Road and Liuhua Road before settling in Pazhou, with exhibition space growing from 9,600 square metres to more than a million. The Pazhou complex opened its first phase in 2004, brought Areas A, B and C fully into service in 2008, launched its fourth-phase expansion in December 2020, opened Area D and the east registration hall on 30 December 2022, and passed overall acceptance in October 2024, creating a four-area layout. Total floor area exceeds 1.62 million square metres, with 620,000 square metres of exhibition space, of which 504,000 square metres are indoors and 116,000 outdoors; the four areas hold 20 halls including five pillar-free halls of 10,000 square metres or more and nearly 6,000 additional booths, making it one of the largest exhibition complexes in the world. The fourth phase continues the "floating" form of Areas A and B, and Hall 18.2 in Area D rises 13 metres at its highest point with over 10,000 square metres and 572 booths. Metro Lines 8 and 11 and the Pazhou Hong Kong-Macau ferry terminal serve the site.

address: 山东省青岛市即墨区温泉街道温泉二路7-1号
intro_zh: 青岛国际博览中心位于山东省青岛市即墨区温泉街道温泉二路7-1号，南邻鳌山湾，东接滨海大道即墨温泉段，由南山集团旗下青岛长基置业投资20亿元建设、美国NBBJ公司设计，2009年12月动工、2011年1月竣工，是青岛东部滨海带规模最大的专业展馆；按建成时的公开资料，其规模居中国北方首位、内地第三。场馆总建筑面积约22万平方米，总展览面积约18万平方米，其中室内展览面积约12万平方米、室外展场约6万平方米、配套功能区约4万平方米，可容纳6000多个国际标准展位。整体分A、B、C及标准展馆四大功能区，建南、北两座登录大厅（南 1.38 万平方米、单层 9,900 平方米、中心大厅 6,000 平方米；北 1.32 万平方米、单层 6,400 平方米）、10座单层无柱标准展厅（展馆）和1座1.3万平方米多功能馆；标准馆单馆建筑面积约1.2万平方米，展厅净尺寸149米×70米（约1.04万平方米）、净高12至18米，地面承重5吨/平方米，每馆可容550个标准展位、配40根升降吊杆，水、电、气、网接口到馆。中央登陆大厅（序厅）约5,000平方米以上，纵深超大跨度、挑高最高可达20米以上，采用通透玻璃幕墙采光；南、北登录大厅是场馆标志性建筑元素，集登记、接待、商务、餐饮与会议于一体。交通方面，地铁11号线（蓝谷快线）设博览中心站，直达展馆；自驾经滨海大道可达，距青岛市政府约50公里，周边配套四、五星级酒店与温泉度假资源。综合会议中心配有大、中、小型会议室、贵宾接待室与新闻发布厅，主会议厅可容上千人，层高约6至9米，配专业同声传译与视听系统。室外露天广场展场面积达数万平方米，适合户外大型机械、房车展、汽车试乘试驾与开幕式庆典。
intro_en: Qingdao International Expo Center is at 7-1 Wenquan Second Road, Wenquan Subdistrict, Jimo District, Qingdao, Shandong, facing Aoshan Bay and connected to the Binhai Avenue coastal road. Invested with RMB 2 billion by Qingdao Changji Real Estate under the Nanshan Group and designed by the American firm NBBJ, it broke ground in December 2009 and was completed in January 2011. At completion public materials described it as the largest international exhibition centre in northern China and the third largest on the mainland. The complex has about 220,000 sqm of floor area and 180,000 sqm of total exhibition space: roughly 120,000 sqm indoors, 60,000 sqm of outdoor yard and 40,000 sqm of supporting functions, enough for more than 6,000 standard booths. It is divided into zones A, B, C and the standard halls, with two registration halls (south 13,800 sqm with a 6,000 sqm central lobby; north 13,200 sqm), ten single-storey column-free standard halls and a 13,000 sqm multifunction hall. Each standard hall has about 12,000 sqm of floor area with a 149 m by 70 m column grid (about 10,430 sqm), a clear height of 12–18 m and a 5 t/sqm (50 kN/sqm) floor load, holding 550 booths with 40 lifting points and water, power, gas and data connections. The registration halls are the architectural signature, combining registration, reception, business, dining and meeting functions. Metro Line 11 (Langu Express) has an Expo Center station serving the site; the drive to the city centre is about 50 km along Binhai Avenue, and four- and five-star hotels and hot-spring resorts cluster nearby. A central arrival hall of more than 5,000 sqm rises over 20 m at its highest point behind a glazed curtain wall, and the conference centre holds a main hall seating more than a thousand people (6–9 m ceilings) with simultaneous interpretation. The outdoor plaza adds tens of thousands of square metres suited to large machinery, caravan shows, test-drive events and opening ceremonies.

address: 深圳市宝安区福海街道会展新城片区
intro_zh: 深圳国际会展中心位于深圳市宝安区福海街道会展新城片区，紧邻深圳宝安国际机场，是深圳市政府投资建设、由招商蛇口与华侨城联合体开发运营的超大型会展综合体，被视为深圳全面扩大开放和粤港澳大湾区核心区建设的战略平台。一期于2016年9月开工、2019年11月启用，落成时以一期规模成为全球最大的会展中心，也是深圳建市以来最大的单体建筑，并首创大型建筑、轨道交通、水利与市政工程同期开发的工程组织方式。项目一期占地121.42万平方米、总建筑面积160.05万平方米，室内展览面积40万平方米，共19个展厅：16个单层无柱标准展厅各2万平方米，17号超大展厅4.8万平方米可承接航展、游艇展一类特殊展览，18号会议中心与20号活动中心各2万平方米。所有标准展厅为大跨度无柱空间，吊点按9米×9米全馆覆盖，地面承重每平方米5吨，可满足重型装备布展。规划采用鱼骨式布局，展厅沿1.75公里双层中央廊道东西对称展开，屋面以彩色丝带花纹寓意“海上丝绸之路”。周边配套地铁12号线、20号线国展站，1.2万个停车位及货车轮候区，经广深沿江高速与机场枢纽快速连通。
intro_en: Shenzhen World Exhibition and Convention Center occupies the Convention and Exhibition New Town area of Fuhai Subdistrict, Bao'an District, next to Shenzhen Bao'an International Airport. Invested in by the Shenzhen municipal government and developed and operated by a China Merchants Shekou and OCT consortium, it is regarded as a strategic platform for the city's opening-up and for the core area of the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area. Phase one broke ground in September 2016 and opened in November 2019; at completion it was the largest exhibition centre in the world by scale, the largest single building ever built in Shenzhen, and the first project to develop a large building alongside rail, water and municipal works simultaneously. Phase one covers 1.2142 million square metres of land with 1.6005 million square metres of floor area and 400,000 square metres of indoor exhibition space in 19 halls: sixteen single-storey pillar-free standard halls of 20,000 square metres each, a 48,000-square-metre super hall suited to aviation and yacht shows, plus a 20,000-square-metre conference centre and a 20,000-square-metre event centre. Standard halls are long-span column-free volumes with a 9-by-9-metre rigging grid throughout and five tonnes per square metre floor loading for heavy machinery. The plan is fishbone-shaped, halls arranged symmetrically along a 1.75-kilometre double-deck central corridor, under a roof patterned with coloured ribbons that evoke the Maritime Silk Road. Metro Lines 12 and 20 serve Guozhan station, with 12,000 parking spaces and a truck holding area nearby.

name_zh: 中国国际展览中心（顺义新馆）
address: 北京市顺义区天竺空港城商务区
intro_zh: 中国国际展览中心（顺义馆）位于北京市顺义区天竺空港城商务区，东邻首都国际机场、西靠温榆河生态走廊，由中国国际贸易促进委员会立项并投资建造，与1985年建成的朝阳馆统筹规划、一体化经营，两馆车程约30分钟。顺义馆2006年9月25日动工，2008年3月建成投用，是北京为缓解大型现代化展馆不足、服务2008年奥运相关工程而建设的重点项目，落成后成为北京规模最大、功能最完善的展览中心。展馆及附属总建筑面积23.14万平方米，由8个可分合的单体、单层、无柱、大空间展厅组成，室内净展览面积10.68万平方米，单个展厅约1.25万平方米，室外展场约5万平方米。每个展厅既可独立承办中小型展览，又能通过内部连廊彼此连通，合并承办大型展会；展馆在布展净高、管廊设计和综合展位箱配置上处于国内外先进行列，可承接重型与轻型国际专业展，也可用于大型集会、演唱会和室内体育比赛。依托两馆一体化经营，顺义馆培育了机床展、汽车展、印刷展、冶金展、玻璃展等知名展会。周边由京密路、五环、六环、机场高速与京承高速构成公路网，地铁15号线国展站直达。
intro_en: The China International Exhibition Center (Shunyi) occupies the Tianzhu Airport City business district in Shunyi District, Beijing, bordering Capital International Airport to the east and the Wenyu River ecological corridor to the west. Initiated and invested in by the China Council for the Promotion of International Trade, it is planned and operated as one system with the Chaoyang venue completed in 1985, about 30 minutes away by road. Construction began on 25 September 2006 and the venue opened in March 2008; it was a key Beijing project aimed at relieving the shortage of large modern exhibition halls and formed part of the city's 2008 Olympic programme, becoming Beijing's largest and best-equipped exhibition centre on completion. The halls and annexes total 231,400 square metres of floor area and comprise eight separable single-storey, pillar-free, large-span halls giving 106,800 square metres of net indoor exhibition space, each hall about 12,500 square metres, with roughly 50,000 square metres of outdoor exhibition ground. Every hall can host a small or medium show on its own or be linked through internal corridors to form a single large event; rigging height, service tunnels and integrated booth boxes are among the most advanced in China, so the venue handles both heavy and light international trade fairs as well as large assemblies, concerts and indoor sports. Under joint operation with the Chaoyang venue it has nurtured well-known shows for machine tools, automobiles, printing, metallurgy and glass.

name_zh: 成都世纪城新国际会展中心
address: 四川省成都市世纪城路198号
intro_zh: 成都世纪城新国际会展中心位于四川省成都市城南新区、天府大道旁，世纪城路198号，2003年12月奠基、2004年12月展馆投入使用，2007年底主体项目全部建成，是成都建设“会展之都”的起点性项目，也是四川乃至中国西部规模最大的展览建筑之一。整个世纪城项目总建筑面积约173万平方米，分展馆区、国际会议区、酒店及文化设施区、商务办公区、商业住宅区五大部分，以“水”为主题、以天鹅湖为中心组织布局。展馆区在东部，9个主馆与8个连接馆共17个展馆呈扇形向府南河展开，主馆单馆1.1万至1.15万平方米、连接馆单馆约800至900平方米，室内展览面积约11万平方米，另有三万平方米室外展场，可搭5500个国际标准展位；展厅为单层无柱结构，净高12至21米（据公开资料，官方未逐馆公布），水、电、光纤接口预埋到位。会议中心面积10万平方米，含30多个会议厅、洽谈厅、贵宾厅和新闻发布中心。建筑以银杏叶状扇形展开，正面临天鹅湖与大型集散广场，货运从侧后方独立进入。交通方面，地铁1号线世纪城站直达展馆，周边有天府大道、绕城高速和数十条公交线路，经天府大道可快速连接成都主城与成都南站。展馆区设北大门、南大门、西大门三处主要出入口，3B、6B 货车入口分别位于 3–4 号馆与 6 号馆一侧，地铁 1 号线世纪城站 C 出口直连西大门。
intro_en: Chengdu Century City New International Convention & Exhibition Center stands beside Tianfu Avenue in the southern new district of Chengdu, Sichuan, at 198 Century City Road. Its cornerstone was laid in December 2003, the exhibition halls opened in December 2004 and the whole project was completed by the end of 2007, making it the starting point of Chengdu's convention-city strategy and one of the largest exhibition complexes in western China. The wider Century City project has about 1.73 million sqm of floor area in five zones — exhibition, international conference, hotels and culture, business offices and housing — organised around Swan Lake and a water theme. The exhibition zone in the east has 17 halls: nine main halls and eight linking halls fanning out towards the Fu Nan River. Main halls are 11,000 to 11,500 sqm each and linking halls about 800–900 sqm each, giving about 110,000 sqm of indoor space plus 30,000 sqm of outdoor exhibition space and 5,500 standard booths. Halls are single-storey and column-free with clear heights of 12–21 m (published sources; not confirmed hall by hall by the venue) and pre-installed water, power and fibre connections. The 100,000 sqm conference centre contains more than 30 meeting, negotiation, VIP and press rooms. The fan-shaped, ginkgo-leaf plan opens onto Swan Lake and a large forecourt, with freight entering from the rear. Metro Line 1 stops at Century City station at the venue, and Tianfu Avenue, the ring expressway and many bus routes serve the area. The site has three main gates (north, south and west); truck entrances 3B and 6B sit by Halls 3–4 and Hall 6, and Century City station (Metro Line 1, Exit C) opens onto the west gate.

address: 上海市浦东新区国展路1099号
intro_zh: 上海世博展览馆位于上海市浦东新区国展路1099号，坐落于原2010年上海世博会园区B片区西侧，是世博会后场馆再利用的代表性案例，也是上海从“办博”走向“常年办展”的重要承载地。场馆前身为2010年上海世博会主题馆，2007年11月动工、2009年9月竣工，现由上海世博（集团）有限公司持有运营，是浦东世博片区最早转为专业展览用途的大型场馆之一。馆内由1至4号展馆组成，另设5号馆及会议、餐饮配套，可承接展览、会议、发布会与赛事活动。室内展览面积约8.1万平方米，其中1号馆单体约2.5万平方米、净高14.7米，另有1.7万平方米、1.2万平方米与1万平方米级展厅，可满足不同规模展会灵活组合。特色在于大跨度无柱空间与世博时期留下的高标准荷载设计，地面承重最高3.5吨/平方米，适合重型设备与大型特装。建筑保留了世博会主题馆的方整体量与银灰色金属屋面，工业感强、识别度高。交通方面紧邻地铁7号线、8号线耀华路站与6号线、7号线高科西路站，周边有卢浦大桥、打浦路隧道连接浦西，距虹桥机场约25公里、浦东机场约35公里。
intro_en: Shanghai World Expo Exhibition & Convention Center sits at 1099 Guozhan Road in Pudong, on the western side of the former Expo 2010 site. Built between 2007 and 2009 as the Expo Theme Pavilion and owned by Shanghai Expo Group, it is one of the earliest large venues in the Expo area converted to year-round exhibition use, symbolising Shanghai's shift from hosting a world expo to running a permanent exhibition district. The complex comprises Halls 1 to 4 plus Hall 5 and supporting conference and catering space. Indoor exhibition area totals about 81,000 sqm, with Hall 1 alone at roughly 25,000 sqm and a 14.7 m clear height, alongside 17,000, 12,000 and 10,000 sqm halls that can be combined flexibly. Its large-span column-free structure and high floor loading of up to 3.5 t/sqm suit heavy machinery and elaborate custom stands. The architecture retains the Expo Theme Pavilion's blocky massing and silver metal roof, giving it a strong industrial identity. Metro Lines 7 and 8 at Yaohua Road and Lines 6 and 7 at Gaoke West Road serve the site, with the Lupu Bridge and Dapu Road Tunnel linking Puxi; Hongqiao Airport is about 25 km away and Pudong Airport about 35 km. It also stages conferences, product launches and sports events, with Hall 5 and catering space completing the complex; hall-level records for five halls accompany this profile.

address: 天津市津南区国展大道888号
intro_zh: 国家会展中心（天津）位于天津市津南区国展大道888号，坐落在海河中游南岸、津滨双城生态屏障核心区，是商务部与天津市政府合作共建的项目，也是继广州、上海之后中国第三个国家级会展项目，承担着服务京津冀协同发展和北方会展经济的枢纽功能。项目由德国GMP与中国建筑科学院联合设计，总建筑面积约138万平方米，分两期建设，一期2021年6月、二期2023年9月相继投入使用，全部建成后是中国北方展览面积最大的会展综合体。场馆有32个单层无柱展厅，室内展览面积40万平方米，室外展览面积15.8万平方米，室内外展览总面积55万平方米，另有2.8万平方米中央大厅承担登录、安检与人流集散，并设4处VIP接待区。配套包括国家会议中心（天津）、万豪酒店群、32万平方米商业配套、9400余个停车位和11万平方米货车轮候区。建筑按绿色建筑三星级标准设计，屋顶铺设光伏、采用地源热泵与雨水回用系统，并以预制装配方式建造。交通以地铁1号线国家会展中心站为核心，D、E、F口出站即达登录大厅，天津大道、国展大道与宁静高速在周边交汇。
intro_en: The National Exhibition and Convention Center (Tianjin) is located at 888 Guozhan Avenue, Jinnan District, on the south bank of the middle Haihe River within the ecological barrier between Tianjin's urban core and Binhai New Area. Co-built by the Ministry of Commerce and the Tianjin municipal government, it is China's third national-level exhibition project after Guangzhou and Shanghai, and acts as a hub for the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region and for northern China's exhibition economy. Designed by Germany's GMP together with the China Academy of Building Research, it offers about 1.38 million square metres of floor area in two phases, the first opened in June 2021 and the second in September 2023, making it the largest exhibition complex in northern China once complete. There are 32 single-storey pillar-free halls, 400,000 square metres of indoor exhibition space and 158,000 square metres outdoors, 550,000 square metres in total, served by a 28,000-square-metre central hall for registration, security and crowd distribution with four VIP reception areas. Supporting facilities include the National Convention Center (Tianjin), a Marriott hotel cluster, 320,000 square metres of commercial space, more than 9,400 parking spaces and an 110,000-square-metre truck holding area. The buildings follow China's three-star green standard, with rooftop photovoltaics, ground-source heat pumps, rainwater reuse and prefabricated assembly. Metro Line 1 stops at Guojiahuizhanzhongxin, where exits D, E and F lead straight to the registration hall.

name_zh: 南昌绿地国际博览中心
address: 江西省南昌市红谷滩区怀玉山大道1315号
intro_zh: 南昌绿地国际博览中心位于江西省南昌市红谷滩区怀玉山大道1315号，地处九龙湖新城，由绿地控股集团投资建设、绿地巴塞罗那会展公司运营，2016年11月投入使用，是南昌发展会展经济的公共建筑、江西省首个UFI会员，也是中部地区重要的国际综合会展中心。场馆总建筑面积约30万平方米，室内净展览面积14万平方米，由上下两层共14个独立展厅组成，每厅约1万平方米，可提供6600个标准展位；室外广场展览面积3万平方米，设2000个停车位。两层之间设夹层，含20个不同规模的会议室；配套五星级绿地铂瑞酒店（400余间客房）和2万平方米会议中心，会议中心有2个2600平方米无柱宴会厅和26个多功能厅。一层展厅承重3.5吨/平方米、二层1.7吨/平方米、室外15吨/平方米，适合重型装备与大型特装。场馆已获美国LEED银级认证和国家绿色三星建筑认证。交通方面，地铁2号线国博站直达展馆A区，501路、503路等公交设国博中心站；南昌西站距场馆约1公里，昌北机场约36.5公里，自驾经九龙大道、怀玉山大道进入。
intro_en: Nanchang Greenland International Expo Center is at 1315 Huaiyushan Avenue, Honggutan District, Nanchang, Jiangxi, in the Jiulonghu new town. Invested by Greenland Holdings and operated by Greenland Barcelona Convention & Exhibition, it opened in November 2016 as Nanchang's public venue for the exhibition economy, the first UFI member in Jiangxi and one of the leading integrated exhibition centres in central China. The building totals about 300,000 sqm, with 140,000 sqm of net indoor exhibition space in 14 independent halls arranged over two levels, each hall about 10,000 sqm, providing 6,600 standard booths. An outdoor plaza adds 30,000 sqm of exhibition space and 2,000 parking spaces. A mezzanine between the two levels holds 20 meeting rooms of different sizes; a five-star Greenland Primus Hotel with more than 400 rooms and a 20,000 sqm conference centre with two 2,600 sqm column-free ballrooms and 26 multifunction rooms support the halls. Floor loading is 3.5 t/sqm on level one, 1.7 t/sqm on level two and 15 t/sqm outdoors, suiting heavy equipment and large custom stands. The venue holds LEED Silver and China Green Building Three-Star certification. Metro Line 2 stops at Guobo station at Zone A; buses 501 and 503 also serve it. Nanchang West railway station is about 1 km away and Changbei Airport 36.5 km. Because the 14 halls sit on two levels, organisers can run concurrent shows on separate floors; hall-level records for all 14 halls accompany this profile.
